ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity pixels (approx. 85-90%) across the fluke body with localized high-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 10-15%) primarily concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottled patch located at the left distal tip; fragmented, high-frequency white pixel speckling and larger clusters located at the right distal tip and sparsely along the right lobe's trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is distinct and well-defined relative to the central lobe transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of peaks and valleys compared to the left lobe. Discrete pixel-level deviations are most pronounced at the lateral extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric sweep; the left lobe follows a low-degree convex curve towards the tip, while the right lobe is oriented vertically with a more pronounced convex sweep along its trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels located at the far lateral margins of both lobes, indicative of localized scarring or encrustation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white mottling and surface irregularities localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
